items.what: Directories passed to _load must be expanded to only files ending in the .conf extension, ignoring others (conf2.d/file2.conf.disabled is not loaded).
Files inside a config directory are loaded in sorted (deterministic) order so later overrides earlier applies predictably.

reason: The instruction implies directories are accepted and snippets loaded, but the exact filtering rule (only *.conf, ignoring e.g. *.conf.disabled) and deterministic sort order are conventions the tests encode; both are guessable from the conf.d convention the instruction itself showcases, and no new API names are required.
